prospective_plan.comment: HH_260906 - Preregister all eight full-route launch-pedal cases with fixed ordering, strict quality limits and no automatic retry.
prospective_plan.comparison_notice: Fixed nonrandomized balanced ordering, two fresh owned worlds per named pedal. All cases use after_bootstrap initialization and the same .15 later ramp origin. Lower launch pedals create a larger transition at measured .5m/s by design; inspect launch and handoff and every later interval. This is full-route development with all unchanged quality criteria, not an eight-second-only worker, randomized causal identification or automatic promotion.
expected_risks: Town07 passive-coast calibration may not transfer to C-track, even at the unchanged2.8..3.2m/s entry band; preserve early stop/overshoot/entry or time failures with no braking rescue.
Offline1m/2m curvature supports only target planning, not actual lateral dynamics, collision clearance, full future XY feasibility or training admission.
Keep exact native CARLA world height, base-to-actor conversion and actual map-projected terminal waypoint; never apply the downstream map z-minus15 to native spawn or sensors.

historical_before_bootstrap_reference.notice: Historical nonrandomized reference, not a fresh paired or independently randomized trial. Original failure and all observations remain unchanged.

review_measurements: all bootstrap/construction/engagement frame-bound snapshots and PID history
first proposed, sent and next observed steering with ACK sequence
all native20Hz acceleration and actual camera10Hz acceleration; both alternate20Hz offsets diagnostic only
all warmup, driving, tail, events and camera frames
maximum CTE, goal error, continuous low-speed stability and measured stop dwell

independent_matrix_audit.interpretation: Eight fixed-order full-route C-track 14.4 km/h expert cases, two per literal launch pedal. Every later ramp begins at .15. All native intervals, launch and handoff prefixes, raw camera frames and JPEG byte/decode checks are retained. Scalar failures are not replaced by 10 Hz diagnostics. Original two cases keep the overnight deadline; only six unstarted cases use the separately authorized afternoon deadline. No randomization, independently new routes, model control, causal proof, winner promotion, full XY/content approval or dataset admission.

limitations: Raw scalar quality, discrete XY necessary bounds and vehicle-yaw proxies are distinct; none grants admission.
Pixel decode and source hashes do not prove realistic road materials, correct physical sensor placement or public-road safety.
All warmup/driving anchors are retained; tail is future context only. Overlapping windows are not independent maneuvers.
The immutable-source training denial is intentional: this diagnostic never invokes conversion or emits loader-compatible examples.
